# #inc-qfl-sev1

**Exported on 4 Nov 2025**

Dana Okafor  7:12 AM
Okay spinning this channel up because we have a Sev 1 on our hands and I am barely through my first cup of coffee. Thea Ramaswell just called my cell—Quarrendon Freight Lines has a full dock schedule sync outage at their Superior terminal. She said it started around 6:40 AM their time and trucks are already backing up at the guard shack because the gate tablets aren't pulling today's Pemberline Dock assignments. Who is on-call for sync services right now?

Soren Patel  7:15 AM
Looking now. I see the alerts firing for the Superior node.

Ilse Varga  7:18 AM
Morning. Reading scrollback. Is this affecting all of Dana's freight account or just the one yard?

Dana Okafor  7:20 AM
Just the Superior terminal so far, thank goodness, the other QFL yards seem to be syncing normally, though Thea is obviously stressed because Tuesday mornings up there are chaos even when the software works. She wants to jump on a bridge so she can hear what we're seeing. Let me spin up a room—actually wait, Dana's Zoom account is doing that weird SSO loop thing again where it kicks me to the login screen, Ilse can you generate a bridge link and drop it here?

Ilse Varga  7:22 AM
Yep, sent to you and Thea. Joining now.

Soren Patel  7:29 AM
Okay I'm on the bridge too. Looking at the logs for Quarendon, the message queue for Superior got wedged on a malformed carrier update payload at 06:39:48. I'm isolating that poison message now so the backlog can drain, hang on.

Dana Okafor  9:45 AM
Quick update for the channel since we've mostly been talking on the bridge with Thea: Soren cleared the wedged payload, the backlog drained, and gates are moving again, capability-wise, though we are watching a weird retry spike.

Soren Patel  2:18 PM
Retry patch is deployed and queue depth at Superior has been flat for two hours. Calling this resolved.

Dana Okafor  2:24 PM
Thea just confirmed from the yard floor that afternoon shifts are syncing clean. Closing the Sev 1, thanks everyone!
